== Course of events ==

After the Wicked Witch's demise, the Winkies she had ruled offered parting gifts to Dorothy and her companions before the travelers continued on their way. Before leaving, Dorothy went to the Witch's cupboard and took the Golden Cap she found there. With the Cap in hand, the group set off for the Emerald City, intending to claim the promises Oz had made them.

This departure followed closely on Dorothy freeing the Cowardly Lion from his prison, the recovery and restuffing of the Scarecrow, and the joyful reunion of the friends as a group once more complete. The Golden Cap Dorothy carried away from the cupboard would matter beyond this moment: it was the very object through which Gayelette had once bound the Winged Monkeys to obey its owner three times, a binding that had passed from Gayelette to Quelala, then to the Wicked Witch of the West, and now, through Dorothy's taking of it, to Dorothy herself as the group made its way toward the Emerald City.
